description: We are two students in Singapore working on AI and software. We built TRIX, an AI medical crew member for astronauts far from Earth. It does two-minute daily health checks against each astronaut’s own normal, uses 13 AI agents with NASA-sourced answers, shows a 3D guide in emergencies, and works offline when the link to Earth is cut. Our skills: AI/ML, multi-agent systems, full-stack web, data and UX design.
